entities.name: Clavileño
entities.description: Legion of Dusk vampire cleric and former paladin, first follower of Vito, given demonic power by Aclazotz.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: Vampire order Clavileño served as paladin.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: Vampire who wished to restore order to the Church; Clavileño's superior.

entities.name: Vona de Iedo
entities.description: Antifex Clavileño became a zealot for.

entities.name: Queen's Bay Company
entities.description: Company whose expedition went to Ixalan.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: Sun Empire warrior who sliced Clavileño's ear and was killed by him.

entities.name: Alta Torrezon
entities.description: Where paladins were ordered to remain.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that decimated the Free Cities of the West.

events.summary: Disillusioned with Queen Miralda's orders, Clavileño becomes a zealot for Vona de Iedo and sails to Ixalan.
events.quote: made Clavileño disillusioned with his monarch

events.summary: Clavileño finds Vito, becomes his first follower and joins his expedition with the Queen's Bay Company.
events.quote: becoming his first follower and joining his expedition

events.summary: After Aclazotz is released, Clavileño, Vito and other vampires become demonic vampire-bats.
In the battle at the core Inti slices Clavileño's ear; Clavileño kills Inti, then is killed by Caparocti Sunborn.
events.quote: He was subsequently killed in revenge by Caparocti Sunborn

relations.quote: before he killed the Sun Empire warrior
